title: Express Yourself with the All-New “People of Pandai” Avatars!
summary: Meet People of Pandai (POP), the all-new avatar collection! Redeem diverse, fun characters with your Pandai Coins in Rewards > Avatar.
body_markdown:
Say hello to a whole new way to show off your personality on Pandai! Introducing People of Pandai (POP), our brand-new avatar collection, packed with fun, quirky and diverse characters just waiting to become the new face of your profile.


For the longest time, your trusty PBot mascot has been with you. Now, it is time to level up. The People of Pandai avatars bring a fresh, human-styled look, so you can pick a character that feels just like you.


## **What Are People of Pandai (POP) Avatars?**


**People of Pandai, or POP for short, is our newest collection of profile avatars.** Think of it as a big upgrade from the classic PBot avatars you already know and love.


Instead of mascots, POP features colourful human characters with each with its own vibe. And the best part? You can unlock them using the Pandai Coins you earn simply by learning.


## **A Style for Every Personality**


No two students are the same, so why should your avatar be? The People of Pandai collection is all about diversity and self-expression.


Browse through characters with different hairstyles, glasses, hijabs, cool accessories and bright, colourful backgrounds. Better yet, each avatar has its own unique code like POP #401 or POP #402, so you can easily find and show off your favourite. Whatever your style, there is a POP avatar that matches it.


## **How to Redeem Your POP Avatar**


Ready to claim your new look? Redeeming a People of Pandai avatar is quick and easy:


1. Open your Pandai account on the web or app.
2. Head to Rewards > Avatar.
3. Browse the People of Pandai collection.
4. Pick your favourite and redeem it for just 200 Pandai Coins.


That is it, your new avatar is ready to wear!


## **How to Earn More Pandai Coins**


Running low on coins? No worries! Earning more is all part of the fun. In fact, every time you learn on Pandai, you get a little closer to your next avatar.


Here is how to stack up more Pandai Coins:


- Answer Pandai Quiz questions and keep your streak going.
- Complete your daily challenges.
- Join other learning activities across the app.


The more you learn, the more you earn and the more avatars you can collect to customize your profile.


## **Find Your POP Avatar Today!**


Your personality deserves the perfect avatar. So go ahead and explore the brand-new People of Pandai collection, then redeem the one that is truly you.


**Open Pandai on your web or app, head to Rewards > Avatar, and meet the People of Pandai!**


**Senang je nak apa? Senang je nak Pandai!**
